name: cursor-usage-stats
description: Monitor Cursor's included request usage and on-demand spending directly in the status bar with configurable threshold alerts.
author: Numan <ahmetnuman95@hotmail.com>

scripts.lint: yarn typecheck && yarn eslint && yarn prettier
scripts.lint:fix: yarn typecheck && yarn eslint:fix && yarn prettier:fix
scripts.pretest: rm -rf out && yarn build && yarn mock generate && tsc -p . --outDir out

cursorUsageStats.showWelcomeMessage.description: Show a welcome notification with quick actions when the extension first loads.

cursorUsageStats.alerts.usageThreshold.p.description: How often to fetch usage data in seconds. Shared between the status bar and threshold alerts.

cursorUsageStats.alerts.usageThreshold.s.description: What to display in the status bar: 'both' shows requests and on-demand, 'requests' shows only request count, 'onDemand' shows only spending.
Which metric determines the status bar color and threshold alert severity.

cursorUsageStats.alerts.usageThreshold.i.description: Usage percentages that trigger warning alerts for included requests. Use an empty array to disable.
Usage percentages that trigger critical alerts for included requests. Use an empty array to disable.

cursorUsageStats.alerts.usageThreshold.o.description: Usage percentages that trigger warning alerts for on-demand spending. Use an empty array to disable.
Usage percentages that trigger critical alerts for on-demand spending. Use an empty array to disable.

cursorUsageStats.alerts.maxModeDetection.description: Enable MAX mode detection alerts. Notifies when any MAX mode call is detected since the last check.
How to display MAX mode alerts. 'toast' shows a standard notification, 'modal' shows a blocking dialog.
How often to check for MAX mode calls in seconds. Default is 5 minutes.

cursorUsageStats.alerts.spendingGuard.en.description: Enable spending guard alerts. Notifies when spending since the last check exceeds the cost threshold.

cursorUsageStats.alerts.spendingGuard.no.description: How to display spending guard alerts. 'toast' shows a standard notification, 'modal' shows a blocking dialog.

cursorUsageStats.alerts.spendingGuard.po.description: How often to check for expensive requests in seconds. Default is 5 minutes.

cursorUsageStats.alerts.spendingGuard.co.description: Dollar amount that triggers the spending guard alert. Alerts when spending since last check exceeds this value.

cursorUsageStats.tips.showOnStartup.description: Show a random AI tip on extension startup.

cursorUsageStats.tips.gistUrl.description: URL to a JSON file containing tips. Must return a JSON array of objects with 'title' (string), 'description' (string), and 'category' (string) fields. Leave empty to use bundled defaults only.

cursorUsageStats.api.includedRequestMode.description: The model key in Cursor's /api/usage response for included requests. Falls back to auto-detecting a key with numRequestsTotal and maxRequestUsage if not found.
